Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
notes: Posted 1 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'STARTING(8)': This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further ('TDIGWATT/PIDAIAF'), All Wrapped Up, Secret Plans, Resistance, Crush The Rebellion, I'm Sorry, Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber and Prepared Defenses; these count toward the 60. Several Effects start and the post names none as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.
Secret Plans and Resistance are the 2001 Effects (Secret Plans; Resistance from Jabba's Palace), not Defensive Shields.

Posted 'SENSE/ RECOIL IN FEAR' is kept as written: Sense & Recoil In Fear is a Light combo and cannot be in this Dark deck; the Dark Sense combo of the time is Sense & Uncertain Is The Future, but the post does not say so.

Posted 'TARKIN X 2' dested Grand Moff Tarkin; 'BOBA W BLASTER' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'IG88 W GUN' IG-88 With Riot Gun; '4 LOM W GUN' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'DAVIN FELTH' Trooper Davin Felth; 'WALLEN' Sergeant Wallen; 'JADE' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'VADER DLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'JADES STICK'/'VADERS STICK' Mara Jade's Lightsaber and Vader's Lightsaber; 'TWILEK' Twi'lek Advisor; 'I HAVE YOU KNOW' I Have You Now; 'ZUCKUSS/DENGAR/BOSSK IN SHIP' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, Dengar In Punishing One and Bossk In Hound's Tooth.
The 'CC' sites, Bespin, Bespin: Cloud City and Disarmed dested the Dark pages; 'CC WEST GALLEY' is Cloud City: West Gallery; 'CC OCCUPATION' is Cloud City Occupation.
The list totals 58 as published: the 'CHARACTERS(19)' header lists 18 characters and 'SHIPS(8)' lists 7 ships.
